steps.what: Inspect supplies and agree children's shopping needs and spending limits
Shop for suitable groceries clothing and care items within agreed limits
Pay for purchases and bring care items home

tasks.design: Keep shopping with the nanny, including checking needs, suitability, payment and transport. An online order is a different fulfilment arrangement whose fees, substitutions and delivery handoff need separate measurement before claiming a saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Needs depend on children's changing sizes, dietary requirements and actual household stock.
tasks.enabler_now: No new capability is required for the retained manual process.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing safe suitable products and handling unavailable items within parental instructions.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising what a particular child needs and checking items directly.
tasks.altitude: Carry out household shopping with clear parental limits.

reach.task: Clarify dietary requirements and permitted substitutions
reach.learn: Which decisions the nanny can make independently

evidence.claim: Physical shopping and suitability decisions remain human work in this design; no saving is asserted.

assumptions: The baseline is ordinary in-person shopping, not a separate recurring order administration task.
The nanny establishes needs in s1; no structured stock, size or substitution feed is assumed.
The parent's existing instructions are an unchanged input and no extra parent capture is introduced.
No system is added, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Shopping distance, delivery availability and the household's existing arrangements
research_questions: Does an existing delivery arrangement reduce total nanny and parent time after substitutions and handoff?

incremental.description: No new system or capture process is introduced

time_saved_range_pct.basis: All 100 baseline hours remain across needs assessment 25, shopping 55 and payment/transport 20. No automation or incremental upkeep is proposed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Own the practical suitability and completion of care shopping.
role.ambitious_version: Provide dependable supplies suited to the child's needs.
